set: 'Anmari…' said alone, trailing off, is a polite 'not really'. Without a negative it means 'too much': anmari da yo! = that's going too far; amari ni takakute kaenakatta = it was so expensive I couldn't buy it. For 'not that …' (sonna ni warukunai), see sonna ni.
sonna ni + negative means 'not that much' (sonna ni takakunai); it has its own entry, sonna ni.
Asks for an opinion, a report or a plan in one word (dou?, dou datta?, dou suru?, dou omou?), and after a noun it suggests (ashita dou?).
The same word means 'in front' (see mae / ushiro). -mae ni after a verb has its own card.
